heading: Non-Solicitation of Customers and Non-Competition
variants: For twelve months after the date of this Agreement, neither party shall, directly or through any other person, solicit or accept business from any person who was a customer of the other party during the six months before that date and with whom it dealt in connection with the Purpose.

For the same period, neither party shall carry on, or be concerned in, any business that competes with the business of the other party in the United Kingdom in the products or services discussed under this Agreement.

Each party agrees that these restrictions are reasonable and no wider than necessary to protect the other party's goodwill and customer connections. If any of them is found unenforceable, it shall apply with the smallest change needed to make it enforceable.

Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for eighteen months after it ends, approach, canvass or deal with any customer or supplier of the other party that it was introduced to, or learnt about, in the course of the discussions under this Agreement, with a view to taking business away from the other party.

During the same period, neither party shall set up, invest in or work for any business that competes with the other party in the market for the products discussed, except by holding less than three per cent of the shares of a listed company.
The parties consider each of these restrictions to be separate and reasonable. If a court finds one of them too wide, the others continue to apply.
